fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of an MSc in data science at Manchester? Here is what we can confirm and what we cannot.

The MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (Computer Science Data Informatics) is a one-year course for students with a strong computer science background. Manchester describes it as a technical, computer-science-focused pathway to advanced data science skills, at a university ranked in the UK top 10 for Computer Science (Times Higher Education World University Rankings by Subject, 2026).

**The most important facts for you:** the entry bar is a high 2:1, and the course page shows **no tuition fee**. Treat the cost on this page as incomplete until Manchester publishes it.

For the wider university, see our [University of Manchester page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-manchester).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** Manchester asks for a high 2:1 honours degree or the overseas equivalent. You need a strong background in computer science, shown by solid programming and software development skills. A 2:1 is a UK honours grade.

**Indian marks.** The DS page gives no percentage or CGPA for India. Manchester's Advanced Computer Science page names about 65% for Indian BTech and BE graduates, but this course page does not say the same, so ask pgt.compsci@manchester.ac.uk or the admissions team.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. You need **IELTS Academic 7** overall with no component below **6.5**.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Manchester's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

**Tuition is NOT CONFIRMED.** Manchester's course page for this programme shows no tuition fee, and the other Data Science and AI pages and the master's fees pages show none either. Ask Manchester for the 2027 international fee before you plan your budget. Do not assume it matches the Advanced Computer Science fee.

Manchester is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, 2027 entry | NOT CONFIRMED |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total without tuition** | **£12,261** |

The sum is £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 = £12,261. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule is **£1,171** for each month of your course outside London, up to **9 months**. You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row. The 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** The DS page does not state a deposit. Manchester's general rule is that you pay a tuition fee deposit before a CAS is issued, but no amount is shown for this course, so none is added. You need a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) for your visa. This is the electronic letter your university issues. You need a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) for your visa. This is the electronic letter your university issues.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

Manchester's **Global Futures Scholarship** for India is worth **£12,000** as a discount on published overseas tuition. It is for applicants domiciled in India who hold an offer for a full-time, on-campus master's starting in September 2027 and who are self-funded. The DS page does not show a start month, so check that this course qualifies. The form is due by **25 April 2027** and is sent only after you have an offer. Half the awards are offered by 15 March 2027 and the rest by 1 June 2027. See the [scholarship page](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/international/country-specific-information/india/scholarships/).

Graduates of Manchester and Manchester Metropolitan University can also get a 10% master's tuition discount.

## Deadlines and intakes

Manchester takes applications in four stages for 2027 entry.

| Stage | Application received by | Update by |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 6 December 2026 | 19 February 2027 |
| 2 | 1 March 2027 | 2 May 2027 |
| 3 | 4 May 2027 | 18 June 2027 |
| 4 | 4 July 2027 | 30 July 2027 |

The page does not show a start month or a January intake, so both are not confirmed. Apply in an early stage so you have time for the deposit, CAS and visa.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rules.** You need a high 2:1 equivalent and a strong computer science background.
2. **Ask for the fee.** Email Manchester for the 2027 international tuition fee and deposit before you apply.
3. **Apply online in a stage.** Start from the [course page](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/masters/courses/list/22195/msc-data-science-and-artificial-intelligence-computer-science-data-informatics/). The last stage closes **4 July 2027**.
4. **Accept your offer.** Submit the scholarship form by **25 April 2027** if you qualify.
5. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate.
6. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.


## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- you have a strong computer science degree at a high 2:1 level
- you want a computer-science-led data science course
- you can get the fee confirmed before you commit

**Think carefully if:**

- you need a confirmed total cost today, because the tuition fee is not published
- your degree is not mainly computer science, because the course expects a strong programming background
- you need a confirmed start month, because the page does not show one

- [Global Futures Scholarships for India](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/international/country-specific-information/india/scholarships/). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [UK student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa), [money you must show](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/money) and [visa fee](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/apply). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [Immigration Rules, Appendix Student](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/immigration-rules/immigration-rules-appendix-student). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [Immigration Health Surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [Academic Technology Approval Scheme](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/academic-technology-approval-scheme). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [Graduate visa](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa) and [Graduate visa costs](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa/how-much-it-costs). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [TB test for visas](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk). Checked on 4 November 2026.

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much does the Manchester MSc Data Science and AI cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: The tuition fee is not confirmed: Manchester's course page shows none. Visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge come to £12,261 before tuition, so add the tuition once Manchester confirms it.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need for Manchester Data Science and AI?
faq_json.a: The course page asks for a high 2:1 or overseas equivalent and gives no India percentage. Ask the admissions team.

faq_json.q: Does Manchester need GRE for MSc Data Science and AI?
faq_json.a: The course page does not mention GRE. It asks for IELTS Academic 7 overall with no component below 6.5.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for Manchester MSc Data Science and AI 2027?
faq_json.a: There are four stages. The last one closes on 4 July 2027.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students at Manchester?
faq_json.a: Yes. The Global Futures Scholarship gives £12,000 off tuition to self-funded applicants domiciled in India. The form is due by 25 April 2027, after you have an offer.
